_doctrine: MFT forward-test cohort — the 4-gate screen survivors (thin coverage + low idio vol + nowcastable metric + crystallization clock), WEIGHTED toward MONTHLY cadence for calibration speed. Each name: feed, cadence, upcoming events (nowcast-datapoint dates = Layer 1, print dates = Layer 2). Populated by the cohort scout 2026-07-08. Paper freezes only until Layer-2 calibration clears. Vol gate = daily HV target <1.5% BUT read on stated components (net-debt/EBITDA <3x + NO live take-private/refi/going-concern) because raw HV is bid/ask-bounce-inflated on thin names — the HV number is reported honestly per name.

_gate_notes.cannabis_MSO_leg: The MSO EQUITIES (VEXTF, AAWH) FAIL the idio-vol/liquidity gate hard (6%+ daily HV, <$65k/day). They are retained as LAYER-1 NOWCAST-ONLY names — we grade whether we can nowcast the state excise metric, NOT a trade. Do not paper-trade them at Layer 2.
_gate_notes.single_casino_leg: The public single-casino universe is thin: most operators are PRIVATE (Elite Casino Resorts) or fail a gate. MCRI (13 analysts) fails thin-coverage; FLL/CNTY fail idio-vol+leverage (the original FLL null). ACEL (route/VGT operator) is the working gaming name — its revenue IS the monthly state VGT feed.
_gate_notes.monthly_retail_leg: BKE is the cleanest surviving monthly-comp reporter. ZUMZ moved to QUARTERLY comps (no longer a monthly PR name) and is higher-vol — dropped from the monthly leg.

BKE.analysts: 1-2 active (up to 9 stale tags); THIN — PASS
BKE.gate: PASS. Net CASH ($266M cash + $24M ST inv, zero debt) → net-debt/EBITDA negative. Daily HV 2.38% but inflated by the annual special-dividend ex-date gap (2026-05-29, 49->45); ex-that-day day-to-day moves ~0.5-1.5%. No take-private/refi/going-concern.
BKE.feed: Buckle IR / BusinessWire monthly net-sales PR (comp-store % + total net sales $). FREE. Corroborate direction intra-month with mall-traffic + denim-category Google Trends. Lead: the monthly PR itself LEADS the quarterly print by ~2 months (3 monthly datapoints per quarter).

HBB.nowcast_feed_2: CONSUMER REVIEW VELOCITY (added 2026-07-08, user insight 'I love my HB kettle'): Amazon Best-Seller-Rank + Walmart/Target/HomeDepot review-count deltas on the top HB/Proctor-Silex SKUs = a DAILY leading proxy for unit sell-through — higher cadence + shorter lead than the ~5wk customs data. Free-scrapeable on Walmart/Target/HD (Amazon BSR needs Keepa/camel). THE BRAND-VS-DISTRIBUTION TEST: if review-health HOLDS while revenue falls -> the share-loss is CHANNEL/shelf (cyclical/fixable), not brand death (terminal) — resolves the court's open share-loss question.
HBB.reframe: the DD said 'losing share' and read it bearishly; the loyal-product angle forks it: brand-death (terminal, avoid) vs distribution-loss (a beloved product losing SHELF, not customers = a cyclical/self-help story). Review-velocity-vs-revenue is the free test the court didn't run.

LCUT.gate: FAIL — DROP. Daily HV 5.78% and net-debt/EBITDA elevated (>3x; leveraged importer). The vol+leverage combo is exactly the FLL-null failure mode. Nowcast feed is clean but the equity is too whippy/levered to forward-test as a trade. Kept out of the paper cohort.
LCUT.feed: Census kitchenware/tableware HS import series — clean, but see gate FAIL.

_signal_classes.consumer_review_velocity: the scuttlebutt/'buy-what-you-know' leg, systematized: daily BSR+review-count deltas on a consumer-product smallcap's top SKUs = a free high-frequency sell-through nowcast big desks can't be bothered to run at smallcap scale but a person who OWNS the product notices first. Applies to the whole consumer-importer sub-cohort (HBB, and any beloved-brand smallcap). Sibling to beauty_virality + social_thesis.
